baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَظُنُّ أَن لَّن يَنصُرَهُ ... فَلْيَنظُرْ ... كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ
baseline_models.mechanism: A no-help judgment generates a deliberately observable test: the subject undertakes a forceful stratagem, then inspects whether his own action can remove the inward pressure that prompted it.

activation_trace.role: Uncertain supposition supplies the no-help premise that the ensuing experiment tries to verify.
Aid that makes someone prevail is the capacity whose alleged absence motivates the test.
Directed sight or reflection turns the action into an inspection of results.
Contrivance and stratagem name the subject's attempted substitute for the help he denies.
Pent-up distress in the chest is the proposed outcome variable of the experiment.

changed_reading.before: A person merely states that God will not help him.
changed_reading.after: The ayah challenges that person to operationalize his claim and discover whether rage-driven self-help can actually alter the grievance inside him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَلْيَمْدُدْ بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject fabricates an extended rope or connection to the overhead sky and then severs that connection. The make-and-break sequence stages an attempt to control the route by which help would be expected to arrive.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out lengthwise supplies the physical extension of the proposed conduit.
A rope or connective means gives the extension an instrumental link function.
The sky or whatever is overhead supplies the vertical terminus of the link.
Severing a connection reverses the preceding act of making one.
Passing away supplies the hoped-for disappearance produced by the severance.

changed_reading.before: The commands describe an arbitrary rope action.
changed_reading.after: They enact a failed control system: construct a route to the source of expected aid, interrupt it yourself, and test whether manipulating the route can make the underlying grievance pass away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence profiles a worshipper who stands on an unstable edge, reverses under trial, loses both temporal horizons, and calculates worship through harm and benefit. The focus experiment therefore becomes retaliatory utility-testing by a conditional worshipper rather than neutral inquiry.

activation_trace.role: Inclining away from a direction makes worship on an edge a structurally unstable stance.
Turning something off its face supplies the reversal that trial provokes.
General deficit binds the loss of world and afterlife to the subject's unstable calculation.
Harm as the contrary of benefit supplies one pole of the subject's utility test.
Benefit as the contrary of harm supplies the other pole of that test.
Stored distress is what remains when the demanded benefit does not arrive on the subject's terms.

structural_cues: 22:11 repeats the focus pair of world and afterlife before 22:15.
22:12-13 move from non-harm and non-benefit to harm being nearer than benefit, immediately before the focus challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edge-worship, reversal under trial, dual-horizon loss, and harm-benefit calculation; I infer that 22:15 continues this behavioral profile and that failed utility becomes rage. A live alternative is that 22:15 addresses a broader challenger rather than the same profile.

changed_reading.before: Any person who doubts divine help is invited to perform a test.
changed_reading.after: The tested person is specifically recognizable as someone who makes allegiance depend on immediate payoff, flips when tried, and then treats a self-authored stunt as leverage against unmet benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sky-fall image shows loss of attachment producing noisy collapse, seizure, and distant casting, while the sky itself is held from falling by God. Extending and cutting a sky-link now reads as anti-holding: the subject can destroy his own anchorage but cannot take over the holding of the cosmos.

activation_trace.role: The rope or connective means is the bond whose handling is being tested.
Cutting connection supplies the focus action that the later fall image reverses into loss of anchorage.
A disturbed, sounding fall supplies the immediate consequence of losing relation to the sky.
Swift seizure turns the unsupported fall into dispersal rather than mastery.
Falling into an abyss supplies the terminal direction of the broken attachment.
Holding and restraining assign actual sky-stability to divine action.
Falling and coming to rest names the event that divine holding prevents.

structural_cues: 22:31 explicitly depicts falling from the sky and being carried to a distant place.
22:65 explicitly assigns the prevention of the sky's fall to God and makes any fall permission-dependent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sky-fall after broken allegiance and a divinely held sky; I infer that the focus make-and-cut sequence parodies control and actually exposes self-unmooring. The live alternative is a strictly local rope instruction with no relational force.

changed_reading.before: A rope to the sky gives the subject access to an upper domain he can manipulate.
changed_reading.after: The severed rope dramatizes only his power to unmoor himself; the surah's actual sky is held outside his control, so cutting produces fall and dispersal rather than leverage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacrifice passage denies that material substances reach God and affirms that inward guarding does. This changes the upward rope from a workable access device into a satire of materialized reach: no constructed object can coerce divine response merely by being extended heavenward.

activation_trace.role: Lengthwise extension supplies the attempt to make access materially continuous.
A rope or means makes that attempted access concrete and instrumental.
The sky supplies the imagined destination of the material reach.
Attaining or reaching structures the explicit contrast between what does not reach God and what does.
Literal flesh supplies one rejected material carrier of access.
Literal blood supplies the second rejected material carrier.
Placing the self under protection supplies the inward disposition that reaches where matter does not.

structural_cues: 22:37 uses a direct not-this-but-that reach contrast: neither flesh nor blood reaches God, but the subjects' taqwa does.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected material reach and accepted inward reach; I infer that 22:15's heavenward apparatus is exposed as a category mistake about access. The alternative is that the sacrifice contrast remains ritual-specific and does not revise the rope scene.

changed_reading.before: The subject may reach or pressure heaven through a sufficiently extended physical means.
changed_reading.after: The rope is a deliberately futile materialization of access: the surah relocates effective reach from upward matter to the guarded orientation of the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later occurrences define divine help through defense, redress for the wronged, protection of communities and worship spaces, and aid after renewed aggression. Help is therefore public vindication under an injustice sequence, not the immediate removal of a claimant's anger.

activation_trace.role: Vindication of the wronged is the focus sense sharpened by the later explicit help scenes.
Turning away harm supplies the protective operation of divine defense.
Grievance and the demand for redress supply the condition under which help is promised.
Vindication explicitly joins divine capacity to people who have been wronged.
The doubled help language creates a reciprocal social chain of supporting and being supported.
Transgressing the limit by aggression supplies the renewed wrong that precedes promised help.
Vindication follows measured retaliation and subsequent aggression rather than raw emotional demand.

structural_cues: 22:39 links permission to fight with having been wronged and immediately asserts divine capacity to help.
22:40 places help inside preservation of multiple worship spaces.
22:60 sequences equivalent response, renewed aggression, and certain divine help.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit injustice-defense-help sequences; I infer that the focus subject mistakes continuing grievance or delayed redress for absence of help. Personal rescue remains a live, broader alternative.

changed_reading.before: Help means making the individual's distress disappear when he wants it to.
changed_reading.after: Help is vindication enacted within justice, defense, and communal preservation; persistent anger is not a valid measurement that such help will never occur.

context_deltas.mechanism: Respite before seizure, human demands for haste, an unfailing promise, and radically different time-counting activate the temporal branches of extending and looking. The subject's stunt now exposes a self-imposed deadline: he lengthens or ends his own interval and treats divine timing as failed aid.

activation_trace.role: An extended term or interval turns the command from merely spatial extension into manipulated waiting time.
Waiting and granting time make the final look an impatience-sensitive observation.
Extended time and respite establish delay as deliberate rather than evidence of incapacity.
Hastening and bringing forward supply the challenger's demand that the schedule contract.
A promise bounded by its own time or place supplies a schedule that does not fail merely because it is delayed.
Counting the counted exposes the mismatch between human and divine measures of a day.

structural_cues: 22:44 and 22:48 repeat respite followed by seizure.
22:47 directly juxtaposes demanded haste, an unfailing promise, and one day counted as a thousand years.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate respite, haste, promise, and unequal counting; I infer that the focus denial of help is generated by a false human deadline. The alternative is that extension remains exclusively a rope motion.

changed_reading.before: The subject tests whether one immediate action proves divine help absent.
changed_reading.after: He is testing an unfailing promise against his own clock, then cutting off the interval himself and mistaking delayed vindication for permanent abandonment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later revelation sequence gives a real removal-and-stabilization mechanism: God removes the satanic casting and makes the signs firm, while the residue becomes a trial for diseased and hardened hearts. The focus subject's scheme therefore targets the wrong object and claims the wrong agency.

activation_trace.role: Causing something to pass away supplies the removal whose agent and object the later sequence corrects.
Human contrivance supplies the rival removal method that fails to govern revelation.
Removal followed by replacement supplies the packet's explicit corrective operation.
Making firm and secure supplies the positive result after the intrusive casting is removed.
Departure from inner soundness relocates the unresolved disturbance into the receiving heart.
Loss of the heart's softness explains why firm signs remain provocative after false insertion is removed.

structural_cues: 22:52 assigns both removal of the satanic casting and confirmation of the signs to God.
22:53-54 contrast diseased or hard hearts with knowledgeable hearts that submit to the recognized truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine removal, firming, and two heart responses; I infer that the focus scheme tries to remove the sign or its provocation while the actual removable intrusion is false casting and the remaining anger diagnoses reception. External adversity remains a live alternative object of the focus anger.

changed_reading.before: The subject's stratagem might remove an external thing that irritates him.
changed_reading.after: His stratagem is directed against what has been made firm, while true removal belongs to God's correction of intrusive falsehood; what persists as rage reveals the condition of the receiving heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's close, recited clear signs produce recognizable rejection in faces and almost break into assault. This supplies a concrete social realization of the focus chain: signs provoke inward rage, rage becomes legible, and forceful handling approaches action against the reciters.

activation_trace.role: Distress stored in the chest is the inward state made outwardly recognizable in the later scene.
Forceful treatment supplies the pressure that the later near-assault nearly converts into action.
Voice following voice supplies the repeated audible delivery that triggers the confrontation.
Manifest signs supply the specific content being recited and resisted.
Recognition from an observable mark makes the internal reaction diagnostically legible.
The face and forward aspect provide the surface on which rejection appears.
Hostile confrontation turns non-recognition into an adversarial stance.
Approaching an act supplies the explicit almost-stage before violence.
The split mapping to forceful treatment activates the focus k-y-d mechanism as embodied coercion.

structural_cues: The branchless س ط و occurrence at 22:72 word 13 supplies the near-assault action against those reciting the signs.
The same ayah repeats both the recitation and the signs before naming the promised fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, visible facial rejection, approach to action, and near assault; I infer that clear signs or their reciters are a concrete candidate for what enrages the focus subject. The broader alternative is any truth that frustrates his demand for control.

changed_reading.before: The source of anger is unspecified private adversity.
changed_reading.after: The surah supplies a public candidate: recited signs expose denial on the face and bring the subject's forceful scheme to the threshold of attacking their bearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fly example stages an explicit capacity audit: collectively invoked substitutes cannot create, recover, or rescue even a small seized thing; seeker and sought are weak, while God is strong and prevailing. The focus apparatus becomes another substitute agency submitted to the same reductive test.

activation_trace.role: An instrumental means supplies the device whose actual capacity is under examination.
Strenuous handling supplies the subject's attempted compensatory agency.
Rendering a comparison visible frames the later scene as an inspectable demonstration.
Extracting something from a predicament names the rescue capacity that the substitutes lack.
The contrary of strength supplies the verdict on both sides of the attempted transaction.
Seeking and searching bind the failed demander and failed object into one weak system.
Strength gathered like the strands of a rope supplies the decisive contrast to the subject's rope device.
Prevailing force locates effective agency with God rather than the manufactured substitute.

structural_cues: 22:73 commands listeners to attend to a demonstration, denies creation and recovery to invoked substitutes even when assembled, and declares both seeker and sought weak.
22:74 immediately contrasts that weakness with divine strength and might.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a failed rescue test and an explicit strength contrast; I infer that 22:15 anticipates the same audit for the subject's self-made means. The alternative is that 22:73 addresses only external objects of worship, not self-reliant technique.

changed_reading.before: The subject's elaborate scheme might rival the help he thinks absent.
changed_reading.after: The command is a reductio: assemble the device and inspect it, but seeker, sought outcome, and substitute means remain one weak system before the actual source of prevailing power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes with the opposite attachment sequence: hold fast to God, who is named protector and helper. This converts the focus rope into a relational contrast between fabricating and severing a means because help is denied, and preserving the protective bond to the explicitly named Helper.

activation_trace.role: A rope or relational means supplies the manufactured bond in the focus scene.
Severing connection names the subject's destructive response to denied help.
A grasp that prevents and protects supplies the commanded opposite of severance.
A fastening by which one holds supplies a direct counterimage to the focus rope.
Protective alliance and supporting closeness define the one to whom the grasp attaches.
The final naming of the Helper resolves the capacity denied at the focus.

structural_cues: 22:78 closes the surah by sequencing striving, communal witness, worship, holding fast to God, and the paired naming of protector and helper.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an imperative to hold, a fastening image, and the final naming of protector and helper; I infer that this is the constructive countermechanism to 22:15's extend-and-cut sequence. The alternative is that the closing command is independent exhortation rather than a retrospective answer.

changed_reading.before: The focus rope is chiefly an implement of self-harm or attempted access.
changed_reading.after: It also images a wrong attachment practice: the denier manufactures and cuts his own means, whereas the surah's answer is to maintain the protecting grasp on the one finally named as Helper.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it supplies the unstated object of cutting as the subject's breath or life and lets the rope imply suspension; it remains anchored in the rope, overhead sky, breath-cutting branch, death-struggle branch, and chest-bound rage. Downstream prose should present it only as an embodied counterfactual exposing the impossibility of curing rage by self-erasure, not as a settled lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بِسَبَبٍ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ثُمَّ لْيَقْطَعْ ... كَيْدُهُۥ مَا يَغِيظُ

activation_trace.role: A rope supplies the physical implement of the terminal experiment.
What is overhead supplies the possible suspension point.
Choking and cutting breath supply the otherwise unstated object of the command.
Struggling as the breath or life departs makes the stratagem reflexively consume its agent.
Rage compressed in the chest is what cutting the breath cannot meaningfully cure.

changed_reading.before: The subject cuts an external rope or channel to alter an external problem.
changed_reading.after: The subject makes his own breath or life the final test medium, revealing that self-termination can silence the experiencer but cannot vindicate the claim or transform the cause of rage.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain and surprising because it activates the rain, flowing-water, rain-passage, and heat branches inside an ayah usually heard as a personal challenge; it remains multiply anchored in help, extension, sky, removal, heat, and the surah's two explicit sky-water descents. Downstream prose should qualify it as a hydraulic analogy for attempted control of relief, not replace the human conflict with a literal irrigation instruction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَنصُرَهُ ... يَمْدُدْ ... إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ ... يُذْهِبَنَّ ... يَغِيظُ

activation_trace.role: Rain as rescue turns denied help into withheld environmental relief.
Water flowing and being replenished supplies a conduit model for the extension.
The sky supplies the source domain of the desired water.
A passing shower activates rain itself inside the proposed removal.
Flaring heat turns rage into the felt pressure that rain-relief would cool.
Causing something to descend supplies the actual direction of sky-borne relief.
Literal water supplies the medium that makes dormant earth move, swell, and grow.
A second caused descent reinforces that relief moves from sky to earth by divine action.
The repeated literal water closes the hydraulic activation chain.
Fresh green growth supplies the observable outcome of true descending relief.

changed_reading.before: The rope scheme is only a desperate personal action.
changed_reading.after: It can also be carried as an impossible human water-control rig: the subject tries to engineer or interrupt sky-relief and cool his grievance, while the surah shows that effective descent and revival operate by another agency.

strongest_changes: The immediate edge-worship sequence turns the focus subject into a conditional worshipper who measures allegiance by immediate harm and benefit.
The explicit help scenes redefine aid as defense and vindication within injustice, not emotional soothing on demand.
The recitation scene at 22:72 gives the otherwise unspecified rage a visible social mechanism and brings forceful contrivance to the threshold of assault.
The final command to hold fast to the protector-helper supplies the constructive opposite of extending and severing a self-made bond.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah activation converted the bizarre vertical stunt into several inspectable systems at once: unstable utility-based allegiance, false control of attachment and timing, misdirected removal, public resistance to signs, a capacity audit of substitutes, and a closing protective counterbond. The split ك و د mapping at 22:72 especially connected mere imminence with the focus image of forceful k-y-d without collapsing the two roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of the object pronoun in يَنصُرَهُ remains unresolved.
The omitted object of لْيَقْطَعْ permits severing a rope, a connection, an interval, or breath; the terminal reading therefore remains exploratory.
The sky can remain a literal overhead terminus or activate a broader domain of divine control and descent.
22:72 is a strong thematic realization of what enrages, but the focus wording does not explicitly identify recited signs as its sole antecedent.
The sky-water model is branch-rich but cross-domain and should remain analogical.
